transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 432 Gaelic Lane?
Yes, this is 432 Gaelic Lane. I’m alone, my son needs a walker, water’s in the house, and I can’t get help from a truck, boat, or seats.
Thank you for confirming your address and situation. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
One person is here. My son is with me and he needs a walker.

I heard you're here with your son who needs a walker. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
My son needs a walker and can’t leave alone. He’s the only one here who can’t get out by himself.
I hear your son needs a walker and can’t leave alone. Is there water inside the home right now?
Yes, water’s inside. My son needs a walker and can’t leave alone.
I hear water’s inside and your son needs a walker. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
No truck, no boat, no seats. My son needs a walker and I can’t leave him alone.
I hear you’re caring for your son with a walker. Let me read that back: 2 people; me needs help leaving because of walker; son needs help leaving because of a walker; water is inside. Is that right?
Yes. Just me and my son. He needs his walker to move. Water’s in the house. No truck, boat, or seats to help.

Got it. Staying put with your son and walker. I've recorded that you need help leaving. No responder has been assigned yet. If water is rising inside, move to the highest floor and call 911 if you can get through. Goodbye.

house_card: Two people: me and son, both need walkers to move. Water inside. English.
